task: Post-phase-14 hardening: close the open technical items left after 14/14 phases — database housekeeping schedule, local cron-to-drain verification, flaky e2e fixes, production status checks for the admin user/overview routes, coverage measurement, duplicate export filename helper, secret scan of history, spec rebuild and docs sync.
acceptanceCriteria: A migration schedules pg_cron housekeeping that deletes consumed domain_event_outbox rows older than a retention window and cron.job_run_details rows older than a retention window; parked (failed, unconsumed) and pending events are never deleted; notification history survives (event_id set null); the migration is a no-op with a NOTICE where pg_cron is unavailable; a down script removes the jobs; integration tests prove the delete predicate

The real local path pg_cron -> pg_net -> POST /api/internal/notifications/drain turns a pending outbox event into a notification, verified against the local Supabase stack with evidence, and local Vault secrets are restored afterwards
The spotlight-board counter and edit-kudo toast e2e flakes are root-caused and fixed without weakening assertions; the full Playwright suite passes in three consecutive runs at 3 workers
npm run test:prod also checks /admin/users and the users, overview and kudos CSV export routes answer 403 to a member and 200 to an admin
adminKudoExportFilename reuses the shared adminCsvFilename with unchanged output
Unit and integration coverage is measured and recorded (no threshold gate imposed)
A secret scan of the full git history reports no leaked secret before any push
Full gates are green on the final code: tsc, lint, unit, db:reset, integration, e2e, prelaunch, build, test:prod
blastRadius: Migration adds scheduled deletes on domain_event_outbox and cron.job_run_details (data mutation, safety-critical). Wrong predicate could drop pending notification events or parked events awaiting manual replay. Other changes are test-only or a pure helper swap.
contracts: notifications.event_id FK is ON DELETE SET NULL (migration 0021) — pruning outbox must not delete notifications
Parked events (failed_at not null, consumed_at null) must stay for manual replay SQL documented in 0021
Migrations stay portable: NOTICE and no change without pg_cron/pg_net (pattern of 0016/0020)
